WoW: Forever

Frost Mage

Freeze the target, then hit it for four times the damage (the tooltip reads +300%). Icy Veins: "with FrostbiteFrostbiteTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec., melee enemies will often not even reach you before killing them."

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Frost build has been tested. Blizzard's one-point milestone talents sit at 11, 16, 21 and 31 points, with the 16-point one new in Forever, so Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets. arrives at exactly level 20 and Ice BlockIce BlockLevel 4 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost15 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secYou become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells. at 25. No source has posted a level 30 build either: the cap only reached 30 on October 1, and none of the three has published one since. The level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs. No guide has recommended it.

What Frost is for

FrostbiteFrostbiteTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec. 3/3 gives every Chill effect you apply a 15% chance to freeze the target. Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets. is instant, has no cooldown, and hits a frozen target for +300%. ShatterShatterTalentCastInstant 3/3 then adds 50% crit against that frozen target for three points.

Icy Veins rates it 3.5/5 for levelling, under the heading "Smooth and Steady, but Not Fast"; Wowhead and ClassicWoW.gg publish no levelling score. Its verdict: "Frost Mages are going to have a comfortable time leveling… slowing and chilling everything they fight keeps them safe."

The drawback, in the same source's words, is "the constant need to stop for mana" — the "not Fast" half of its heading. You will drink often.

On damage the published line is "Frost Mage won't top the damage meters, but few specs are as safe or as consistent."

Stat priority

Icy Veins is the only one of the three tracked sources that ranks Frost's stats; its order:

  1. Hit — "capping your Hit Chance is a high priority". Nobody publishes the actual cap: "There will be a cap where you can stop investing in this, but we don't know what it is yet."
  2. Spell Power (Frost) — scales every spell and your wand damage
  3. Critical strike — "Frost Mage is a crit-based spec": Ice ShardsIce ShardsTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%. doubles the crit-damage bonus at 5/5
  4. Spirit — "Frost Mages have limited tools for resource management, so Spirit will be a good stat to increase where you can"
  5. Intellect — a bigger mana pool for a whole pull, plus a small crit bonus
  6. Stamina — a dump stat that comes along for free on most gear (Agility and Strength trail further behind, and Strength is explicitly "not useful")

What Forever changed for Frost

  • Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets. and Fingers of FrostFingers of FrostTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec. are both brand new, and together they are the spec.
  • The slows were cut hard, and Blizzard says why. Improved BlizzardImproved BlizzardTalentCastInstantAdds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec. maxes at 40% (Classic: 65%; rank 1 is 15% against Classic's 30%), cut to stop Frost Mages AoE-farming instances "widely used by gold farmers and boosters to disrupt the economy of the game". Cone of ColdCone of ColdSpell · Frost · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost120 ManaCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration8 secInflicts Frost damage to enemies in a cone in front of the caster, reducing their movement speed for 8 sec. lost duration against the same kiting: 40% over 6 seconds, down from 50% over 8. PermafrostPermafrostTalentCastInstantIncreases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%. now extends Chill effects by 11/22/33% instead of a flat 1/2/3 seconds, so it cannot stretch Improved BlizzardImproved BlizzardTalentCastInstantAdds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec. any further; it still adds 10% slow at 3/3.
  • Winter's ChillWinter's ChillTalentCastInstant now applies only to your own FrostboltFrostboltSpell · Frost · Rank 1 of 11Cast3 sec castCost90 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration4 secInflicts Frost damage to an enemy and reduces its movement speed for 4 sec. and Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets., where Classic let any Frost spell apply it. Its application does not roll separately to resist. Blizzard's reasoning: the triggering spell already had to hit, so a second resist roll was redundant.
  • FrostbiteFrostbiteTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec. moved columns, Frost ChannelingFrost ChannelingTalentCastInstantReduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 15% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 30%. moved up to row 3, and Ice BlockIce BlockLevel 4 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost15 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secYou become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells. moved up to row 4 and is now the 16-point milestone talent. Ice BarrierIce BarrierLevel 40 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost305 ManaCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration60 secInstantly shields you, absorbing 431 damage. Lasts 60 sec. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage. now requires Cold SnapCold SnapTalentCastInstantCooldown600 sec cooldownFinishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells. rather than Ice Block, a change the deep dive does not mention either way.
  • Frostfire BoltFrostfire BoltLevel 40 · Spell · Rank 1 of 3Cast3 sec castCost205 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration9 secLaunches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 100 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 27 Frostfire damage over 9 sec. This spell will be checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resists and counts as both Frost and Fire damage. counts as both a Frost and a Fire spell, so Frost talents and Fire talents both apply to it. It uses the higher of your two spell damage bonuses and the lower of the target's two resistances. Rank 1 is level 40, so nobody in the beta has cast it.
  • Downranking is no longer free, and this spec feels it first. A spell cast well below your level gets less benefit from Spell Power and a reduced chance to trigger your own talents. Blizzard's own example is this spec's: a rank 1 FrostboltFrostboltSpell · Frost · Rank 1 of 11Cast3 sec castCost90 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration4 secInflicts Frost damage to an enemy and reduces its movement speed for 4 sec. at level 60 has a 0% chance to proc FrostbiteFrostbiteTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.. Rank-1 Frostbolt spam for a cheap slow was a standard Frost habit; cast near your trained rank now if you want the freeze.
